BundleInfo.name: ChimeraX-CorrectRotamer
BundleInfo.Author: Genki Terashi
BundleInfo.Synopsis: Automated local-MDFF correction of ISOLDE rotamer outliers
BundleInfo.Description: Enumerates ISOLDE canonical rotamers for existing outliers and performs probability-ordered local ISOLDE MDFF annealing and minimization trials with a restrained backbone. The outlier threshold is configurable and the active region is focused.

Classifiers.ChimeraXClassifier: ChimeraX :: Tool :: Rotamer Optimizer :: Validation :: Automated rotamer correction with local ISOLDE MDFF
ChimeraX :: Command :: correctrotamers :: Validation :: Correct ISOLDE rotamer outliers using map density
ChimeraX :: Command :: correctrotamers mdff :: Validation :: Optimize rotamer outliers using local ISOLDE MDFF
